2607.11008.title: SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Robust Open-Vocabulary Dense Perception
2607.11008.paper_summary: Open-vocabulary dense perception (OVDP) aims to localize objects unseen during training by leveraging textual knowledge. Despite the remarkable progress of recent CLIP-based approaches, we identify a critical limitation: synonym-induced grounding inconsistency, where semantically equivalent expressions yield disparate spatial attention patterns. This inconsistency undermines the robustness and performance of existing methods in real-world OVDP applications. To address this issue, we propose SynCLIP, a Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining framework that enhances synonym-robust grounding for OVDP. SynCLIP introduces a Semantic-consistent Spatial Attention alignment (SSA) module to enhance spatial attention consistency by minimizing discrepancies between attention maps of original and synonymous expressions. Furthermore, a Spatial Attention Refinement (SAR) module selectively strengthens the most semantically relevant spatial regions within aligned maps for more precise and stable grounding. To support synonym-coherent pretraining, we also construct a Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC), which augments each category with multiple synonyms and textual definitions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SynCLIP substantially improves grounding consistency under diverse linguistic variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance among CLIP-based OVDP methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Justlovesmile/SynCLIP.
2607.11008.paper_summary_zh: 開放詞彙密集感知（OVDP）旨在通過利用文本知識來定位訓練期間未見過的物體。儘管最近基於CLIP的方法取得了顯著進展，但我們識別出一個關鍵限制：同義詞引起的基礎不一致性，即語義等價的表達產生不同的空間注意模式。這種不一致性削弱了現有方法在現實世界OVDP應用中的穩健性和性能。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了SynCLIP，一個同義詞一致的語言-圖像預訓練框架，旨在增強OVDP的同義詞穩健基礎。SynCLIP引入了一個語義一致的空間注意對齊（SSA）模塊，通過最小化原始和同義表達的注意圖之間的差異來增強空間注意的一致性。此外，空間注意精煉（SAR）模塊選擇性地加強對齊圖中最具語義相關性的空間區域，以實現更精確和穩定的基礎。為了支持同義詞一致的預訓練，我們還構建了一個同義詞豐富的視覺語料庫（SEViC），該語料庫為每個類別增添了多個同義詞和文本定義。在多個基準上的廣泛實驗表明，SynCLIP在不同語言變體下顯著改善了基礎一致性，並在基於CLIP的OVDP方法中達到了最先進的性能。代碼可在 https://github.com/Justlovesmile/SynCLIP 獲得。
